description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY.md §3.2: user now holds DSN-level read plus a genuine table_perms read grant. Before the fix, ReadAbstractRows's inverted check denied exactly this legitimately-granted caller; it must now succeed. (§3.1's fix is what makes this DSN -- Restricted but not Secured, see perm-01 -- enforce table_perms at all; the decisive proof that enforcement is really happening, rather than just being switched off, is the denial in perm-08.)
